findings: Real rotlib binary fixture lives at /home/marielle/repos/mosaist/testfiles/rotlib.bin
AA_NAMES has 18 entries: ALA ARG ASN ASP CYS GLN GLU HIS ILE LEU LYS MET PHE SER THR TRP TYR VAL (excludes GLY and PRO)
Sentinel is 9999.0 (not MSL's 999.0) — exact float equality comparison in backbone_bin
Bin index formula: phi_ind * n_psi_bins + psi_ind (phi-major, MSL line 405)
Tie-breaking: first/lower bin index wins (MSL strict-less-than minDist > dist pattern)
Grid validation: unique_phi.len() * unique_psi.len() == nb AND no duplicate (phi,psi)
Frame algorithm: x_raw = ca-n, z_raw = cross(x_raw, c-ca), y_raw = cross(z_raw, x_raw)
switch_frames: T2_inv * translate(ori) * T1 where T2_inv = T2T for orthonormal T2
ALA sidechain = exactly CB; ARG has >=5 atoms (CG, CD, NE, CZ, NH1, NH2, CB)
counts_as_sidechain: CB=true for ALA only; N/CA/C/O always false; H* always false
PlacedRotamer.atoms does NOT include backbone atoms — library stores only sidechain in canonical frame
Integration tests requiring real rotlib.bin should be #[ignore] to keep CI hermetic
Negative format tests require hand-crafted binary blobs written in test helpers
query: Test plan for proxide-rotlib: 6 test modules covering load, binning, probability, placement, frame, sidechain

conclusion: All formulas match. The 0.29 difference in freedom values must come from input data differences.

findings.mosaist_formula: n1 = survivingRotamers[res].size() - cp.size(); n2 = n1; for(...) { if(cp/100 < loCollProbCut) n1 += 1; if(cp/100 < hiCollProbCut) n2 += 1; } freedom[res] = sqrt((n1*n1 + n2*n2)/2)/numLibraryRotamers[res]
findings.proxide_formula: let n1 = n_uncontested + coll_prob.values().filter(|&&v| v / 100.0 < lo_cut).count() as f64; let n2 = n_uncontested + coll_prob.values().filter(|&&v| v / 100.0 < hi_cut).count() as f64; ((n1 * n1 + n2 * n2) / 2.0).sqrt() / n_library as f64
